nativeBenchPolicy.baselineAndCandidate: one process each, serial; criterion native solver work only

wasmPolicy.processState: fresh process each run; module/JIT and default memos retained within process; fresh restored kernel for each edit

normalization: Only redundant after-state replaced by verified equality and its content hash; no source/package/native/input identities or timing policy changed.

baselineNativeBuild.temporaryBenchmarkRegistration: Only new torus bench registration; no dependency/profile changes
